purpose: Machine-readable contract for raw pilot observations before C3 coding and C4/C5 inference.
important_boundary: Raw observations must not contain inferred mastery, developmental position, prerequisite status, causal claims, or next-action decisions.

required_fields.task_id: pre-specified task from pilot task set
required_fields.evidence_target_ids: one or more pre-specified evidence targets
required_fields.variation_metadata: structured description of planned variation actually presented
required_fields.interaction_events: ordered raw interaction events where available
required_fields.response: raw learner response or structured response payload
required_fields.instruction_exposure: structured exposure metadata; never inferred from performance

missingness.rule: Missingness must be explicit and must never be silently converted to incorrect, mismatch, or negative evidence.

immutability.correction_rule: Corrections create a new version or correction record; the original raw observation is retained.
